title: Pineapple cake near Vineyard or Marsden Park? 100% eggless, Riverstone
summary:
Pineapple cake without eggs, made fresh to order in Riverstone. No eggs in the sponge, none in the cream. That's not a compromise. That's the point.

If you're in Vineyard, Marsden Park or Schofields and can't find a pineapple cake that's genuinely egg-free, this is the answer. A 6-inch starts at $39.99 and serves 6-8. Order by Wednesday for a Friday pickup, which is why a 2-day lead time is all we need.

Pickup from Riverstone Village. Order online or send a message.
